primary.$description: The accent fill: the one main button per screen, checked checkboxes, the job progress bar. Dark: accent 450. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 4.03:1 on surface-selected, 5.01:1 on surface-raised.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover. Dark: accent 950. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.47:1 on primary, 6.85:1 on primary-hover.

primary-hover.$description: Hover state of primary fills. Dark: accent 400.

primary-container.$description: The accent at low strength for small marks only (a selected tab underline background, a count badge). Not for rows or blocks: in dark it is a deep violet (quality.craft.both-themes). Dark: accent 800.

on-primary-container.$description: Text on primary-container. Dark: accent 250. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 8.87:1 on primary-container.

secondary.$description: Neutral fill (no second brand hue): toggled toolbar buttons. Dark: neutral 300.

on-secondary.$description: Text on secondary. Dark: neutral 950. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 10.22:1 on secondary.

secondary-container.$description: Neutral fill: the Assigned chip, inactive segmented controls, filter chips. Dark: neutral 750.

on-secondary-container.$description: Text on secondary-container. Dark: neutral 250. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 7.68:1 on secondary-container.

surface.$description: Page canvas behind everything. Dark: neutral 950.

surface-raised.$description: Panels, tables, forms on the canvas; lifted by shadow-raised (dark: one stop lighter than the page, plus the shadow). Dark: neutral 900.

surface-overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, comboboxes, tooltips, toasts, dialogs, with shadow-overlay. Dark: neutral 800.

surface-hover.$description: Hover on rows, list items, and ghost/secondary controls that sit on surface-raised (dark: one stop lighter than raised). Dark: neutral 850.

surface-selected.$description: Selected rows and list items: one neutral step stronger than surface-hover, in both themes (quality.craft.quiet-states). The accent appears only as a detail: the checked box and the primary left edge. Dark: neutral 800.

surface-overlay-hover.$description: Highlighted item inside a floating layer (menu, select, combobox): one stop off surface-overlay. Dark: neutral 750.

surface-subtle.$description: Quiet zones and inset wells: the sidebar, a toolbar band, inline messages inside panels. Same tone as the page. Dark: neutral 950.

surface-featured.$description: The one thing a screen leads with (the job that needs action), with shadow-featured. Dark: neutral 850.

on-surface-inverse.$description: Text on surface-inverse. Dark: neutral 850. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 12.88:1 on surface-inverse.

on-surface.$description: Default text and icons on every neutral surface. Dark: neutral 50. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 13.52:1 on primary-container, 18.33:1 on surface, 16.83:1 on surface-raised, 13.53:1 on surface-overlay, 15.19:1 on surface-hover, 11.71:1 on surface-overlay-hover, 15.19:1 on surface-featured, 18.33:1 on surface-subtle, 13.53:1 on surface-selected.

on-surface-muted.$description: Secondary text: metadata, column headers, timestamps, placeholders. Dark: neutral 350. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 8.46:1 on surface, 7.77:1 on surface-raised, 6.25:1 on surface-overlay, 7.01:1 on surface-hover, 7.01:1 on surface-featured, 6.24:1 on primary-container, 5.41:1 on surface-overlay-hover, 6.25:1 on surface-selected, 8.46:1 on surface-subtle, 5.41:1 on secondary-container, 8.46:1 on surface.

on-surface-faint.$description: Tertiary text: least important metadata, empty-cell dashes. Never for anything a person must read to act. Dark: neutral 400. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.84:1 on surface, 6.28:1 on surface-raised, 5.67:1 on surface-featured.

border.$description: Hairlines: dividers between table rows and under the table header. Decorative; not required to meet 3:1. Dark: neutral 750.

border-focus.$description: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px. Dark: accent 400. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.05:1 on surface-selected, 6.84:1 on surface, 6.29:1 on surface-raised, 5.05:1 on surface-overlay, 5.67:1 on surface-featured.

link.$description: Inline text links (underlined). Dark: accent 400. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.05:1 on surface-selected, 6.84:1 on surface, 6.29:1 on surface-raised, 5.67:1 on surface-featured.

error.$description: Error text and icons on surfaces; destructive outline; Parts hold dot. Dark: red 400. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.83:1 on surface-subtle, 6.27:1 on surface-raised, 5.04:1 on surface-overlay, 6.83:1 on surface, 6.83:1 on surface-subtle, 6.27:1 on surface-raised, 5.65:1 on error-container.

on-error.$description: Text on error fills. Dark: red 950. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.86:1 on error.

error-container.$description: Parts hold chips and other small marks (not message blocks). Dark: red 850.

on-error-container.$description: Text on error-container. Dark: red 250. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.93:1 on error-container, 8.86:1 on surface-overlay.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons; Running late dot. Dark: amber 400. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.84:1 on surface-subtle, 6.28:1 on surface-raised, 6.84:1 on surface-subtle, 5.67:1 on warning-container.

on-warning.$description: Text on warning fills. Dark: amber 950. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.85:1 on warning.

warning-container.$description: Running late chips and other small marks. Dark: amber 850.

on-warning-container.$description: Text on warning-container. Dark: amber 250. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.97:1 on warning-container.

success.$description: Success text and icons; On site and Done dots. Dark: green 400. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.84:1 on surface-subtle, 6.28:1 on surface-raised, 6.84:1 on surface-subtle, 5.67:1 on success-container.

on-success.$description: Text on success fills. Dark: green 950. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.88:1 on success.

success-container.$description: On site and Done chips and other small marks. Dark: green 850.

on-success-container.$description: Text on success-container. Dark: green 250. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.97:1 on success-container.

info.$description: Info text and icons; En route dot. Distinct from the violet accent by hue (blue about 263, violet about 293). Dark: blue 400. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.88:1 on surface-subtle, 6.32:1 on surface-raised, 6.88:1 on surface-subtle, 5.71:1 on info-container.

on-info.$description: Text on info fills. Dark: blue 950. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.9:1 on info.

info-container.$description: En route chips and other small marks. Dark: blue 850.

on-info-container.$description: Text on info-container. Dark: blue 250. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.99:1 on info-container.
